posts.text: IRCON International — Is Long-Term Holding Still Justified? — One of the biggest mistakes investors make is becoming emotionally attached to their purchase price. Just because we bought a stock at ₹280 doesn’t mean it will return to that level. The market doesn’t know our buying price, so the real question is whether the stock is worth holding at its current price or whether that money could generate better returns elsewhere.
